title: ReportCreate
description: Citizen disaster report submitted to POST /v1/public/platforms/{slug}/reports. lat/lon must be provided together; reports without coordinates are stored but never clustered.

category.description: Report category key enabled on the platform (e.g. road_collapse).

address.description: Internal only; masked on public surfaces.

reporter_contact.description: PII — never public; hashed to count unique reporters.

client_key.description: Stable per-device key; only a salted hash is stored.
